modules.title: 打开 /posts，Next.js 先找哪个文件？
网址怎样找到页面并准备内容

items.title: 网址对应文件位置
items.text: 在 App Router 写法里，/posts 对应 app/posts/page.tsx。

items.title: 服务端准备内容，浏览器负责呈现
items.text: 页面可以在服务器端先从数据库取数据并拼好 HTML，再交给浏览器显示，减少前端白屏时间。

items.title: 用 'use client' 区分交互组件
items.text: 组件默认在服务端运行；需要用户交互（如 onClick、useState）的组件，必须在文件顶部加上 'use client'。如果 AI 写的代码报 “useState only works in Client Components”，通常就是少写了这一行。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 同一个 Next.js 项目同时可能有服务器代码和浏览器代码，必须通过 'use client' 明确划分；密钥只能留在不会发送到浏览器的服务器一侧。

lessonPractice.title: 内容站用 React，需要每篇文章有独立网址、可被搜索引擎读取，并统一处理页面结构。Next.js 适合负责什么？

options.label: 负责路由、页面渲染和数据加载组织，业务存储与权限仍单独实现
options.feedback: Next.js 扩展 React 的网站结构和渲染能力，不会自动生成符合业务的数据与授权。

options.label: 安装 Next.js 后，文章数据库、登录权限和后台管理会自动完成
options.feedback: 框架提供构建能力，不知道项目的数据模型、账号规则或管理流程。

options.label: 只要页面里有一个 React 按钮，就必须迁移整个项目到 Next.js
options.feedback: 单个组件不需要完整网站框架，是否采用取决于路由、渲染和部署任务。

en.title: A React content site needs a URL per article, search-readable pages, and consistent page structure. What should Next.js own?

options.label: Organize routing, page rendering, and data loading while storage and permissions remain explicit
options.feedback: Next.js extends React with site structure and rendering, but cannot invent the project's business data or authorization.

options.label: Install Next.js and receive an article database, login permissions, and admin workflow automatically
options.feedback: The framework provides building capabilities, not the project's data model, account rules, or operations.

options.label: Migrate the entire project to Next.js whenever one React button appears
options.feedback: One component does not require a full-site framework; the choice depends on routing, rendering, and deployment.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用 Next.js 组织文章动态路由、页面元信息和数据加载，保持现有 React 组件可复用。不要假设框架自动提供数据库或权限；列出文章存储、登录和部署仍需实现的部分并逐项验收。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use Next.js for article routes, page metadata, and data loading while reusing current React components. Do not assume automatic storage or permissions; list and verify the remaining article storage, login, and deployment work.

learning.assumes: You know a URL such as /posts can open a page.
learning.outcome: You can connect `/posts` to `app/posts/page.tsx` in an App Router project and tell whether data is prepared before or after the browser receives the page.

modules.title: How a URL becomes a prepared page

items.title: The URL maps to a file
items.text: In the App Router, `/posts` maps to `app/posts/page.tsx`.

items.title: The server prepares content for the browser
items.text: The page can fetch an article list and prepare HTML on the server before sending it to the browser, reducing white-screen wait times.

items.title: Mark interactive components with 'use client'
items.text: Components run on the server by default. Those requiring user interaction (onClick, useState) must have 'use client' at the top. The common 'useState only works in Client Components' error means this directive is missing.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: One Next.js project can contain server and browser code, and you must explicitly mark browser code with 'use client'. Secrets must stay on the server side and never be sent to the browser.
